mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.5% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST > 1200), a decline in housing starts signals cooling in the housing market, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1200 and HOUST declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
